notes.title: [Test-Build] Localization (Version 0.1.3a_007)
notes.notes:
Localization has finally arrived! The game now supports besides English the german language. The language will automatically set to your system language (if available). You can also manually select the language using the -language parameter (e.g., -language=en). There are more languages planned in the future.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138017/0837a4c2d69e7b8bbc93b3f8c3a880c4ef1ff84e.png"]

The build is now available to all testers.

notes.title: [Test-Build] Rework Progress (Version 0.1.1a_023)
notes.notes:
Features

 Stats added (local saving only)
 Mouse- und touch control buttons added
 Stats are showing up on the debug menu now


Design

 Library lighting set to a warmer white
 Added a few book shelves to the library


Bug Fixes

 Camera angle and position fixed for library
 Lighting bugs fixed
 Texture UVs fixed
 no more reporting while mouse is over ui elements


Known Issues

 Stats will be reset after game restart
 There are anomalies, that are triggered more often than others.
 aprox. 200 texture UV errors to fix


Please report new bugs and ask your questions on the discord server.

notes.title: [Test Version] Progress with the Full Gameplay Rework
notes.notes: Anomalies are fixable again. New notice windows for successful and failed reports were added. There are only a few anomalies in Room1 and Room2 which can be triggered with the K key for testing. A new Discord server for a direct communication about the development was created and is now linked on the store page.
